1.note: 表示“在……期间”，这里指在晨会期间，故选 during。
1.zh: 学生们被提醒在晨会期间要集中注意力。

2.note: 句中有明确的过去时间状语 “yesterday”（昨天），主语 “Devi” 为单数，因此系动词用 “was”。
2.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Past Tense (Singular)
2.zh: 昨天吃早饭时，当妈妈做了她最喜欢的煎饼，德维感到很惊喜。

3.note: “when” 引导的时间状语从句使用的是过去时（took），主句也应使用过去时；主语是 “Joshua and his sister”（复数），因此用 “were”。
3.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense — Past Tense (Plural)
3.zh: 当父亲带乔舒亚和他的姐姐去操场时，他们非常兴奋。

4.note: 句中有提示语 “Please stop...”（请停止……）和时间副词 “now”（现在），表明说话人正在进行的动作，需用现在进行时。
4.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Present Continuous Tense
4.zh: “请不要这么吵！我正在看书呢，”艾哈迈德对他的弟弟说。

5.note: 句首有明确的过去时间状语 “Last night”（昨晚），且是在去派对之前已经完成的事实，需用一般过去时，buy 的过去式为 bought。
5.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Simple Past Tense
5.zh: 昨晚，在去派对之前，我父母从那家店买了一件礼物。

6.note: “While” 引导的时间状语从句表示一个持续性的背景动作，与主句中杰里米的过去动作（went）相对比，从句需用过去进行时。因为主语 everyone 视为单数，所以用 was eating。
6.concept: 动词时态 — Verb Tenses — Past Continuous Tense
6.zh: 当大家都在食堂吃饭时，杰里米去了图书馆。

7.note: 句中有空间远指词 “over there”（在那里），且修饰的对象 “girls” 是复数，因此选用远指复数指示代词 “those”。
7.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — those
7.zh: 站在那边的那些女孩为比赛准备了最好的服装。

8.note: 固定关联词搭配 “both ... and ...”，表示“既……又……”，用于连接两个并列的形容词。
8.concept: 连词搭配 — Correlative Conjunctions — both and
8.zh: 简的短篇故事既有创意又有意思。

9.note: “people” 是可数名词复数，不能用 much 修饰；结合前文“决定不坐公交车”以及 “long queue”（长队）的语境，表示排队的人“很多”，故选 many。
9.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — countable nouns
9.zh: 山姆决定不坐公交车，因为长队里人太多了。

10.note: “chilli” 在此处作为调味品，表示辣椒（粉/酱），是不可数名词，不能用 few 或 many 修饰；结合前句“汤不够辣”，说明里面的辣椒“太少”，故选 little。
10.concept: 数量词修饰 — Quantifiers — uncountable nouns
10.zh: 这汤不够辣。里面的辣椒太少了。

11.zh: 我钦佩杰克的诚实，因为他总是说实话。
11.note: “honesty”意思是“诚实”，与后文“总是说实话（always tells the truth）”完美对应。

choices.eg: The teacher praised the boy for his honesty when he admitted his mistake.
Her intense curiosity drove her to open the ancient wooden chest.

12.zh: 汤姆修改了他母亲的配方，以改善冰淇淋的口味。
12.note: “revised”意思是“修改、修订”，符合为了改善（improve）产品而对原本的设计或配方进行调整的语境。

choices.eg: The author revised the final chapters of the book based on public feedback.

13.zh: 巴拉非常激动，当他发现自己赢了保龄球比赛时笑了出来。
13.note: “thrilled”意思是“非常激动的、欣喜若狂的”，与赢了比赛并露出笑容（smiled）的快乐情绪契合。

choices.eg: The children were thrilled to bits when they arrived at the theme park.

14.zh: 玛丽亚姆觉得烤蛋糕很困难。她没有认真阅读说明书。
14.note: “carefully”意思是“认真地、仔细地”，修饰阅读动作，解释了因为没认真读说明书而觉得做这件事很困难的原因。

choices.eg: She spent her prize money wisely by investing in academic books.
The books were stacked neatly in rows across the wooden shelves.

15.zh: 托马斯向他的朋友低声说道，他有一个秘密想要私下分享。
15.note: “whispered”意思是“低声说、耳语”，与后文的“秘密（secret）”和“私下（in private）”完美吻合。

choices.eg: The committee members agreed to the new proposal after a brief debate.
He shouted for help when his boat began to capsize in the rough river.

16.zh: 陈先生很庆幸自己在自行车事故中只受了轻伤。
16.note: “grateful”意思是“感激的、庆幸的”，面对事故只受了轻伤（only suffered minor injuries）的结果，通常会感到庆幸。

choices.eg: The wild animals are often fearful of fire and steer clear of campfires.

29.stem_plain: Siti washes the plates. Then she places them on the table.

30.stem_plain: The flowers are pretty. The flowers are in the vase.

31.stem_plain: Mrs Tan saw a rat in the drain. Mrs Tan screamed.

32.stem_plain: "I'm going to the park tomorrow." Ravi told his brother.

29.concept: 时间状语从句 — Temporal Clause ('before')
29.zh: 西蒂在把盘子放在桌上之前，先洗了盘子。
29.note: before 意为“在……之前”。根据动作的先后顺序，洗盘子发生在放盘子之前，因此 before 引导放盘子的动作，同时需要去掉表示先后顺序的副词 Then。
29.answer: Siti washes the plates before she places them on the table.

30.concept: 定语从句 — Relative Clause (Subject Pronoun 'which')
30.zh: 花瓶里的那些花很漂亮。
30.note: which 引导定语从句，修饰非人类的先行词 The flowers。从句需紧跟在它修饰的主语后，然后再接主句的其余部分（谓语和表语）。
30.answer: The flowers which are in the vase are pretty.

31.concept: 时间状语从句 — Temporal Clause ('When')
31.zh: 当陈太太看到水沟里有一只老鼠时，她尖叫了起来。
31.note: When 引导时间状语从句。连接时需要注意把第二句重复的名词 Mrs Tan 替换为代词 she，且主从句之间用逗号隔开。
31.answer: When Mrs Tan saw a rat in the drain, she screamed.

32.concept: 直接引语变间接引语 — Direct to Indirect Speech
32.zh: 拉维告诉他的哥哥/弟弟他第二天要去公园。
32.note: 主句动词为过去时 told。引语中的第一人称 I 需转为 he；时态 am going 需回退为过去进行时 was going；时间状语 tomorrow 必须转换为 the next day 或 the following day。
32.answer: Ravi told his brother that he was going to the park the next day.

40.note: 对应原文第2-4行：丈夫在周末帮忙（因为平时要在邮局工作），孩子们在不上学的时候帮忙（when they do not have school）。两者结合即为‘当他们不需要去工作或上学时’，故选 (4)。

41.note: 对应第二段（第6-10行）：首先清晨4:00去清理货架 (1)；接着把送到的蔬菜整齐地摆放在货架上 (2)；摆放好之后，清扫地板 (3)。因此排序为 2, 3, 1。

42.note: 对应原文第10-11行：'Sometimes, the vegetables are delivered late. Mr Ong calls Madam Salmah whenever this happens.' 当蔬菜送达迟到时，王先生就会给她打电话。

43.note: 对应原文第15-16行：'Aziz loves arranging the vegetables neatly in small baskets.' 把蔬菜整齐地放进篮子里是 Aziz 做的事，因此 Aziz 勾选，Amina 留空。

44.note: 对应原文第16-17行：关于 Aziz，'he greets them and asks them politely...'。向顾客打招呼是 Aziz 做的事，因此 Aziz 勾选，Amina 留空。

45.note: 对应原文第17-19行：关于 Amina，'She enjoys packing vegetables and handing them to the customers.' 把蔬菜递给顾客（passes/handing them）是 Amina 做的事，因此 Aziz 留空，Amina 勾选。

46.note: 对应原文第19-21行：'Sometimes, they do not have enough money to pay for the vegetables. Madam Salmah usually tells her children to give them a discount.' 妈妈通过在顾客钱不够时让孩子们给他们打折的方式，身体力行地教导孩子们保持友善。
46.answer: When the customers do not have enough money to pay for the vegetables, she tells her children to give them a discount.

47.note: 对应最后一段（第22-24行）：'She never fails to smile at them. She also likes sharing cooking tips with them.' 吸引顾客回购的两件事是：一总是对他们微笑，二喜欢和他们分享烹饪技巧。
47.answer:
i. She never fails to smile at them.
ii. She likes sharing cooking tips with them.

lines.1: Madam Salmah runs a vegetable stall at Jalan Ah Hoot Wet Market.
lines.2: Her husband helps out at the stall on weekends as he works at a post office
lines.3: on weekdays. Her children, Aziz and Amina, help her when they do not have
lines.4: school. Madam Salmah is very hardworking and never grumbles although she
lines.5: feels tired running the stall alone most of the time.
lines.6: She starts the day as early as 4.00 am. She goes to her stall to clean
lines.7: the shelves. At 5.00 am, Mr Ong, her vegetable supplier, delivers fresh
lines.8: vegetables in crates to her stall. Madam Salmah then starts unpacking the
lines.9: vegetables carefully from the crates. After she arranges them neatly on the
lines.10: shelves, she sweeps the floor. Sometimes, the vegetables are delivered late.
lines.11: Mr Ong calls Madam Salmah whenever this happens. She appreciates his
lines.13: During the weekends and school holidays, Aziz and Amina go to the
lines.14: stall to help their mother. Amina sorts the vegetables and removes those that
lines.15: are no longer fresh. Aziz loves arranging the vegetables neatly in small
lines.16: baskets. He also enjoys talking to the customers. They find him adorable as
lines.17: he greets them and asks them politely to buy their vegetables. Amina is quiet
lines.18: but hardworking. She enjoys packing vegetables and handing them to the
lines.19: customers. Sometimes, they do not have enough money to pay for the
lines.20: vegetables. Madam Salmah usually tells her children to give them a discount.
lines.21: She reminds Aziz and Amina to be kind.
lines.22: Madam Salmah's regular customers like her excellent service. She
lines.23: never fails to smile at them. She also likes sharing cooking tips with them.

paragraphs.1: 萨尔玛女士在阿胡路菜市场经营着一个蔬菜摊。她的丈夫周末会在摊位上帮忙，因为他周一到周五在邮局工作。她的孩子们，阿齐兹和阿米娜，在不上学的时候也会来帮她。萨尔玛女士非常勤劳，尽管大多数时候她一个人经营摊位感到很累，但她从来不抱怨。
paragraphs.6: 她早在凌晨4:00就开始了新的一天。她去摊位清理货架。凌晨5:00，她的蔬菜供应商王先生将装在板箱里的新鲜蔬菜送到她的摊位。随后，萨尔玛女士开始小心翼翼地从箱子里取出蔬菜。她把蔬菜整齐地摆放在货架上之后，就会清扫地板。有时蔬菜会送达得比较晚。每当发生这种情况时，王先生都会给萨尔玛女士打电话。她非常感谢他的体贴。
paragraphs.13: 在周末和学校假期期间，阿齐兹和阿米娜会去摊位帮助他们的母亲。阿米娜对蔬菜进行分类，并拿走那些不再新鲜的蔬菜。阿齐兹喜欢把蔬菜整齐地摆放在小篮子里。他也喜欢和顾客聊天。顾客们觉得他很可爱，因为他会向他们打招呼，并礼貌地请他们买自己的蔬菜。阿米娜性格安静但很勤劳。她喜欢把蔬菜打包并递给顾客。有时，顾客没有足够的钱来付菜款。萨尔玛女士通常会告诉她的孩子们给他们打个折。她提醒阿齐兹和阿米娜要待人友善。
paragraphs.22: 萨尔玛女士的熟客很喜欢她优质的服务。她总是对他们微笑着。她也喜欢和他们分享烹饪技巧。这就是为什么他们总是回来向她买蔬菜的原因。
